label: String Consolidation
title: Frontend String Consolidation — Display Verification
subtitle: feature/ui-string-consolidation (PR #6): every user-facing string was moved into strings.js across 19 commits and 3 gap-audit sweeps. The automated check (every STRINGS.* reference and data-str* attribute resolves) already passed — it can't catch a key that resolves but is semantically wrong (copy/paste grabbed the wrong key, or a template function's arguments landed in the wrong order). This checklist targets exactly that risk, prioritized by where it's most likely: multi-argument interpolated strings, and the specific spots touched by the 3 gap-audit sweeps.

sections.title: Priority 1 — Analyzer tab (heaviest edits, 17+ findings across 3 sweeps)
items: Open a demo, Player Details tab: hero card subtitle shows the team name in caps (e.g. "ALLIES" or "AXIS"), not "UNASSIGNED" for a player with a real team
Player Details: status line reads "Steam ID: <the actual id>" — label and value in the right order, not swapped

Player Details stat cards read correctly: "MATCH SCORE", "KILLS", "DEATHS" with a "X.XX K/D" badge (not "K/D X.XX" or missing the K/D text), "AVG. LIFESPAN" with a value ending in "s" and a "Min: Ns / Max: Ns" badge below it
Player Details Kill Streaks table: first sub-row of each streak shows "—" for delta (not blank/undefined), later rows show "+M:SS"
Kill Streaks weapon filter buttons read "[Grenades]", "[Melee]", "[Allied]", "[Axis]", and "[Other]" (if any uncategorized weapons exist) — not raw weapon codes, not missing brackets
Clicking a weapon-filter category button toggles Show All/Hide All correctly and the tooltip text matches (hover shows "Hide all" when weapons are visible, "Show all" when hidden)

Team Details / Scoreboard heading reads like "Scoreboard: Allies (N) > Axis (N)" (or "="/"<") with the correct comparison symbol matching which team is actually ahead — deliberately check a match where Axis is ahead, not just the default case
Team Score Timeline: hovering a point shows a tooltip with the correct team label ("Allies"/"British"/"Axis") and score — not the wrong team's color/label paired with the other team's data
Team Score Timeline: the left axis label at the start reads "0:00", not blank or a stray character

Chat Log tab: Team filter dropdown shows "All", "Allies", "British", "Axis", "Spectators" as the visible option text — pick each one and confirm it actually filters by that team (i.e. the underlying value wasn't scrambled relative to the label)
Summary tab: File size shows "X.XX MB" (not just a bare number, not "undefined MB")
Summary tab: Match duration shows an "Xh Ym Zs"-style value for a long match, and just "Zs" for a very short one (0 rounds) — not "undefined" or a raw NaN
Rounds tab: Start Time and Duration columns both show "Xh Ym Zs"/"Zs"-style durations, not blank
A demo with a partial recording (started late or ended early) shows the correct warning banner text with a real clock value — not "??:??" unless the demo genuinely has no clock data for that field
Demos list (left panel): Type column shows "POV" or "HLTV" correctly per demo, Map column shows the map name or "—" for missing, Date column shows a formatted date or "—"

sections.title: Priority 2 — Highlight Details (detail_pane.js)
items: Streak rows: Details column shows the real weapon-chain string when available, falls back to "N kills" (not "undefined kills") when it isn't
Status dropdown shows all four options in order: None, Pending, Captured, Rendered — and the currently-selected one matches the row's actual status
A row from a merged take shows a badge reading "merged → <take name>" (arrow direction and take name both correct, not swapped or truncated wrong)
Hovering the merged badge shows a tooltip like "Merged with N other highlight(s) into one take..." with the right count (total minus 1, not the raw merge count)
Kill Range column shows a duration ending in "s" (e.g. "4.2s"), not a bare number
Advanced Diagnostics timeline canvas: the two axis labels read "Tick <min>" and "Tick <max>" with the correct min/max values (min on the left, max on the right, not swapped)

sections.title: Priority 3 — Multi-argument interpolated strings (highest risk for argument-order mixups), spot-check a few per pane
items: Master Queue: hover a tracked demo's badge — tooltip reads "Tracked — has <reasons>. Protected from Clear Untracked in Workspace mode." with reasons that actually match that demo's state (status/note/edited range)
Master Queue: click Remove on a tracked demo — confirm dialog names the correct demo and mentions what will be lost
Capture Studio: trigger a disk-space warning with multiple bad paths — message correctly says "required" GB vs "available" GB in the right order, not swapped
Capture Studio: after a batch, toast reads "X/Y takes captured" or similar with X and Y in the right order (captured count first, total second)
Render Studio: after a scan, status reads "Status: Scan complete — N take(s) found" with the right count
Render Studio: NVENC concurrency warning names the actual configured concurrent-renders number, not a hardcoded/stale one
Demo Auditor: duplicate group toggle reads "▶ Group (N files)" / "▼ Group (N files)" with the correct file count and arrow direction matching expanded/collapsed state
Demo Auditor: Delete Selected button label updates to "Delete N Selected File(s)" matching the actual number of checked rows

Clear Selected / Clear All modals: summary sentence correctly states how many demos are affected and how many of those have tracked work — deliberately test with a mix of tracked and untracked demos to confirm the two counts aren't swapped

sections.title: Priority 4 — Everything else (lower risk, straight 1:1 literal swaps — spot check only)
items: Top nav: tab labels, Quick-Clip/Workspace toggle caption text, Save/Load Session button labels all read as expected
Capture Studio: Export Configuration panel tab labels, field labels, and placeholders all read correctly (Path Routing, Timing Options, Capture Output, Custom Commands)
Render Studio: table headers (Clip Name, Stream, Frames, Date, Settings, Status, Speed, Progress, Actions) all present and correctly labeled
Demo Auditor: table headers and empty-state text read correctly with no folder selected yet
General: no visible "undefined", blank text where a label is expected, or literal key-path-looking text (e.g. "ANALYZER.SOME_KEY") anywhere in the app during normal use
